entities.summary: Pahlavi, a notable figure in the history of Iran, associated with Pahlavi Dynasty and Modernization (1925–1941). Preceded by Reza Khan deposes the Qajars and founds the Pahlavi dynasty. Their legacy influenced Iran renamed from Persia by government decree and CIA-MI6 coup d'état overthrows Mossadegh and restores the Shah's power.
